source_title: Name the moon phase you see
source_description: Match the moon you see to a phase name on a chart, and point to the lit side.

source_title: Find one constellation with a chart
source_description: Use a chart to find one named star pattern, then find it again with the chart lowered.

source_title: Watch a point of light move
source_description: Watch a steady point of light cross the sky and say whether it moved like a plane or stayed with the stars.

source_title: Name three clouds from a chart
source_description: Match three clouds you can see to names on a cloud chart.

source_title: Tell dew from rain on a leaf
source_description: Say whether water on a leaf is dew or rain, and what clue you used.

source_title: Read a rain gauge you set out
source_description: Set a gauge or a straight-sided cup, read the depth, and empty it.

source_title: Name a star color you can see
source_description: Call one star white, blue-white, or reddish, and say if you cannot tell.

source_title: Tell a butterfly from a moth
source_description: Use one feature you can see, and a chart, to say butterfly, moth, or not sure.

source_title: Tell moss from lichen
source_description: Point to moss and lichen, or say you found only one.

source_title: Match a shell to its outline
source_description: Draw a shell's outline and fit the shell back into it.

source_title: Copy a fossil outline
source_description: Copy the outline of a fossil or a fossil photo and name one part you are not calling a species.

source_title: Tell a needle leaf from a broad leaf
source_description: Sort leaves or photos into needles and broad leaves.

source_title: Count birds you can separate
source_description: Count birds you can tell apart in one view, without naming the species.

source_title: Note which way a shell coils
source_description: Hold a spiral shell and say whether the opening is on the left or the right when the tip is up.

source_title: Tell a web from a nest
source_description: Point to a web and a nest, or say which one you cannot find.

source_title: Write three bird sounds as words
source_description: Write three sounds you hear as your own syllables, without a species name.

source_title: Name a flower part from a chart
source_description: Point to a petal and one other part, using a chart, on a flower you may touch or a photo.

source_title: Tell a round arch from a pointed arch
source_description: Point to an arch and say whether the top is round or pointed.

source_title: Tell a mosaic from a fresco in a photo
source_description: Say whether a picture is made of pieces or painted onto a surface, using a photo or a work you can see.

source_title: Find a keystone
source_description: Point to the center stone of an arch, or say the arch has no separate center stone.

source_title: Tell a column from a pilaster
source_description: Say whether a vertical support stands free or is flat against the wall.

source_title: Count the panes in one window
source_description: Count the glass panes in one window and say if a bar is a frame or a reflection.

source_title: Felt a small wool ball
source_description: Wet and roll wool until it holds as a ball that does not pull apart.

source_title: Sew a snap so it closes
source_description: Sew one half of a snap to scrap cloth and show that it can meet the other half.

source_title: Sew a French knot
source_description: Sew one French knot that stays raised, then two more in a row.

source_title: Tell a knit stitch from a purl
source_description: On a knitted sample, point to a smooth stitch and a bumpy stitch.

source_title: Wind a bobbin evenly
source_description: Wind thread onto a bobbin so it does not pile on one side.

source_title: Thread a needle and knot the thread
source_description: Thread a needle, knot the end, and show the knot does not pull through.

source_title: Sew a hook and eye
source_description: Sew a hook and an eye on two scraps so they catch.

source_title: Tell the right side of a cloth
source_description: Point to the side of a cloth that is meant to show, and say the clue.

source_title: Coil a small clay pot
source_description: Stack clay coils into a small pot that stands.

source_title: Burnish a clay surface
source_description: Rub a leather-hard clay surface until a patch turns smooth and slightly shiny.

source_title: Roll a clay slab with an even edge
source_description: Roll a clay slab and show that two edges are close to the same thickness.

source_title: Level a horizon in a photo
source_description: Take a photo with a horizon and say whether it tilts, then take one that looks level.

source_title: Place a subject on a third
source_description: Take a photo with the subject near a third of the frame, not dead center, and say which third.

source_title: Photograph one object in shade and sun
source_description: Photograph the same object in shade and in sun and say what the light changed.

source_title: Make a pinhole camera
source_description: Make a dark box with one pinhole and see an image on the tracing-paper screen.

source_title: Change lines on a transit map
source_description: On a transit map, name the station where you would change to reach a stop on another line.

source_title: Read a bus headsign
source_description: Read the destination on a bus or a photo of a headsign and say what it does not tell you.

source_title: Tell odd and even street numbers
source_description: Walk or read a short row of house numbers and say which side is odd.

source_title: Find a house number between two others
source_description: Given two house numbers, point to where a missing number would fall.

source_title: Wait for the walk sign
source_description: At a crossing with a signal, wait until the walk sign shows and say what you did when it did not.

source_title: Tell a plucked note from a bowed one
source_description: Hear two string sounds and say which was plucked and which was bowed.

source_title: Name an instrument family
source_description: Hear one instrument and name its family, such as strings, winds, or percussion, not the piece.

source_title: Point to the louder of two sounds
source_description: Hear two sounds and point to the louder one, then say if they were close.

source_title: Lower a needle onto a record
source_description: Lower a tonearm onto a record you may play, and lift it without dragging across the grooves.

source_title: Write a catalog card
source_description: Write three fields for one object: what it is, where it is, and a date or a blank you will not invent.

source_title: Sort a shelf by a rule you wrote
source_description: Write one sorting rule, sort a short shelf by it, and find one item by that rule.

source_title: Spot a duplicate in a list
source_description: Find one repeated entry in a list you wrote, or say the list has none.

source_title: Tell a QR code from a barcode
source_description: Point to a QR code and a barcode and say what each is for in one sentence.

source_title: Read a seed packet
source_description: Read the plant name, a sowing depth or spacing, and one thing the packet does not promise.

source_title: Deadhead one spent bloom
source_description: Remove one spent bloom and leave the bud below it.

source_title: Tie a stem to a stake
source_description: Tie a soft tie so a stem is supported and not choked.

source_title: Thin seedlings you sowed
source_description: Remove extra seedlings so the ones you keep have space, and say how you chose.

source_title: Pot on a seedling
source_description: Move a seedling into a larger pot and water it so the soil settles.

source_title: Undo a find-and-replace
source_description: Replace a word in a copy of a note, then undo it and show the original word.

source_title: Use one shortcut until it sticks
source_description: Use one keyboard shortcut three times for the same action, without the mouse.

source_title: Turn on captions and read a line
source_description: Turn on captions for a short clip and read one line aloud as it appears.

source_title: Rotate a photo upright
source_description: Rotate a sideways photo until the subject is upright, and do not crop it.

source_title: Zip three files and open them
source_description: Put three files in one archive, open it, and show the three names.

source_title: Tell serif from sans serif
source_description: Point to a serif letter and a sans-serif letter on signs or a page.

source_title: Expand an abbreviation you looked up
source_description: Find an abbreviation, look it up, and write the words, or say the source did not define it.

source_title: Read a fiber on a care label
source_description: Read one fiber from a care label and say one thing the label does not tell you.

source_title: Spot a palindrome
source_description: Find or write a word or short phrase that reads the same forward and back.

source_title: Play one hopscotch turn
source_description: Hop a short hopscotch court you drew, pick up the marker, and come back.

source_title: Walk with a book on your head
source_description: Walk a short line with a light book balanced on your head and say when it falls.

source_title: Catch with the other hand
source_description: Catch a soft ball with the hand you do not usually catch with.

source_title: Lash two sticks together
source_description: Lash two sticks at a crossing so they stay when you lift one end.

source_title: Hammer a brad straight
source_description: Start a brad in scrap wood, move your fingers away, and drive it until the head sits near the surface.

source_title: Knot a friendship bracelet
source_description: Knot a short bracelet from embroidery floss so the knots make a repeating band.

source_title: Print a leaf
source_description: Ink or paint the back of a leaf and print it once on paper.

source_title: Cover a book corner
source_description: Fold a paper cover over a book or a dummy so one corner is neat and the title can still be read.

source_title: Measure a trunk with string
source_description: Put a string around a tree trunk at about chest height and mark the length.

source_title: Estimate a height with a pencil
source_description: Use a pencil at arm's length to compare a tree or a building with a known height, and say it is an estimate.

source_title: Copy a simple border
source_description: Copy a short repeating border from a photo or a tile and stop where your repeat breaks.

source_title: Set an eyelet in scrap
source_description: Punch a hole in scrap and set an eyelet so a lace can pass through.

source_title: Set a chessboard to the start
source_description: Set the starting chess position and say which corner holds a light square on the right.

source_title: Finish a dots-and-boxes square
source_description: Play a small dots-and-boxes grid until you close one square on purpose.

source_title: Complete a three-by-three magic square
source_description: Place the digits one through nine so each row sums to the same number, and check one column.

source_title: Watch for a satellite pass
source_description: Use a prediction or a known time, watch the sky, and say whether a steady light crossed.

source_title: Tell a bulb from a seed
source_description: Point to a bulb and a seed and say one difference you can see.

source_title: Read a garden label
source_description: Read the plant name on a garden label and one growing note, and say if the name is worn off.

source_title: Match a thread to a cloth
source_description: Choose the closer of two threads to a cloth, in the light you will sew in.

source_title: Tell warp from weft
source_description: On a woven cloth, point to the threads that run the length and the threads that run across.

source_title: Read one knitting symbol
source_description: Point to one symbol on a knitting chart and say the stitch the legend gives.

source_title: Tie a netting knot
source_description: Tie a netting knot that joins two loops of cord and holds a light tug.

source_title: Sketch a door and its hinge side
source_description: Sketch a door and mark the side the hinges are on.

source_title: Read a bilingual sign
source_description: On a sign with two languages, point to the place name and say which line is which language if you can.

source_title: Write alt text for one image
source_description: Write one sentence that says what an image shows, and leave out a guess about why.

source_title: Check a file date before you replace it
source_description: Read the date on a file, then decide whether a second copy is newer.

source_title: Read a record speed
source_description: Read the speed on a record label and set the player, or say the player cannot match it.

source_title: Mark a tide line from the shore
source_description: Mark the wet line on a shore you can reach safely, and later say whether it moved.

source_title: See which way the water moves
source_description: From the bank, say which way a leaf or a stick on the water travels.

source_title: Tell a cone from a needle bunch
source_description: Point to a cone and a bunch of needles, or say the tree shows only one.

source_title: Note the time of the first bird
source_description: Write the time you first hear a bird on a morning you chose, and do not name the species.

source_title: Sort shells by one feature
source_description: Sort empty shells by one feature you name, such as ridged or smooth.

source_title: Tell a portrait from a still life
source_description: Say whether a picture is mainly a person or mainly objects, and point to the clue.

source_title: Name a medium from a label
source_description: Read the medium on a gallery label, such as oil or watercolor, and do not guess if it is missing.

source_title: Read a menu price
source_description: Read one item and its price, and say whether a tax or a tip is included if the menu says.

source_title: Bind a sketchbook with a band
source_description: Put pages between two covers and close them with a band so they do not fall when you hold the book up.

source_title: Tell a still moment from motion blur
source_description: Point to a sharp subject and a blurred moving part in a photo, or say the photo is all sharp.

source_title: Count the lines of a haiku you wrote
source_description: Write three short lines and count the syllables, then change one line that is off.

source_title: Clap a limerick you wrote
source_description: Write five short lines and clap the beats so the third and fourth lines are shorter.

source_title: Read a fuse number and stop
source_description: Read the number printed on a fuse or a fuse photo, and do not put the fuse into anything.

source_title: Name a plug shape
source_description: Name the shape of a plug you can see, and do not wire it.

source_title: Add a page number
source_description: Add a page number to a short document and show it on two pages.

source_title: Set a thermostat and set it back
source_description: Change a thermostat by one step, read the new number, and set it back.

source_title: Reverse a cushion
source_description: Turn a cushion over or around and say what that hid.

source_title: Read a battery size
source_description: Read the size on a battery and match it to a slot that shows the same size, without forcing it.

source_title: Tell landscape from portrait orientation
source_description: Say whether a frame is wider than it is tall, and turn one photo to the other orientation.

source_title: Name a door as single or double
source_description: Say whether a doorway has one leaf or two, and which leaf has the lock if you can see it.

source_title: Read a platform clock against a timetable
source_description: Read a station clock and a listed departure and say whether you are early or late for that listing.

source_title: Shelve three books by call number
source_description: Put three books in call-number order and say where a fourth number would go.

source_title: Tell a sewn binding from a glued one
source_description: Open a book and say whether you can see threads in the gutter or only glue.

source_title: Count petals in fours or fives
source_description: Count the petals on one flower and say whether they come in fours, fives, or neither.

source_title: Tell a simple leaf from a compound leaf
source_description: Say whether one leaf stalk holds one blade or several leaflets.

source_title: Name the season clues on one tree
source_description: From one tree, say which season clues you can see, such as bare twigs, flowers, full leaves, or fruit.

source_title: Tell frost from dew
source_description: Say whether a white or wet coating is ice or liquid water, and how you can tell.

source_title: Tell a slide brass from valves
source_description: From a photo or an instrument you may look at, say whether the brass instrument uses a slide or valves.

source_title: Tell a reed from an open mouthpiece
source_description: Point to a reed mouthpiece and a lip-blown open mouthpiece, or say you can see only one.

source_title: Read a dynamic mark
source_description: Point to p or f in a score and say quieter or louder, without playing the piece.

source_title: Read a repeat sign
source_description: Point to a repeat sign and say what returns, without performing the music.

source_title: Level a measuring spoon
source_description: Fill a measuring spoon level with a dry ingredient and scrape the extra off.

source_title: Tell a raw edge from a hemmed edge
source_description: Point to a raw edge and a hemmed edge on cloth you may handle.

source_title: Read a grainline arrow
source_description: On a pattern piece, point to the grainline arrow and lay it along the cloth length.

source_title: Mark one pattern size
source_description: On a multi-size pattern, mark only the size you chose and say which line you will not cut.

source_title: Tell a left glove from a right
source_description: Put two gloves in a pair and say which is the left.

source_title: Read a shoe size and its limit
source_description: Read the size printed in a shoe and say that the number is not a promise it will fit.

source_title: Use a hand saw
source_description: A blade near the hands. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Service a gas boiler
source_description: Gas and combustion. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Abseil a cliff
source_description: A fall from height. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Enter a confined space
source_description: Air and entrapment. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Weld with an arc
source_description: Electricity, light, and heat. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Ride a motorcycle in traffic
source_description: Traffic injury. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Clean a chimney
source_description: Height, soot, and fire residue. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Harvest a wasp nest
source_description: Stings. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Jump from a height into water
source_description: Impact and drowning. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Replace a brake hose
source_description: Vehicle braking. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Use a winch under load
source_description: A stored load can release. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Distill alcohol
source_description: Fire, vapor, and law. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Open a beehive
source_description: Stings and a living colony. No method written. Kept for specialist review.

source_title: Base jump
source_description: A fall. No method written. Kept for specialist review.
